findings.text: follow-on: negative_control_log names logs/negative-control-guard-test.log, whose first line paraphrases a different mutation, while the declared mutation is evidenced by logs/negative-control.log, so the declaration and the log a reader compares against it describe two different experiments.

follow-on: the guard fails only the allocation verbs, so a test reaching squeue, scontrol or scancel is recorded but not failed, narrower than the goal's "fails any test that reaches a scheduler verb it did not provide"; the narrowing answers a prior finding that a liveness probe was turned red, but leaves tests/test_crew_placed_liveness.py::test_the_payload_log_decides_that_the_work_ran still reaching the host's real squeue.
follow-on: changed_paths omits tests/test_concurrency_bound_refuses_by_name.py, which the diff changes at lines 44-128.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 008a18f12; b62d9fde adds the guard and the recording scheduler, aa1ce2bab narrows it and adds the committed check, 5ab11b97 and 9457ce8a add evidence prose, nothing outside the scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for like-for-like whole-suite arms, a shim log with no salloc or sbatch, and a negative control naming salloc; logs/suite-head2.log records 137 failed / 9008 passed at 9457ce8af and logs/reach-head.tsv holds no salloc for reckon-reservation, but the log named at manifest.md:11 evidences a different mutation than the declaration.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal names the tests whose dispatch reaches a real salloc through ensure_reservation, gives each a full scheduler it provides, and adds a guard failing a test that reaches an unprovided verb; tests/conftest.py:376 adds the guard and tests/test_concurrency_bound_refuses_by_name.py:124 gives the one reaching test a recording scheduler.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head arm 137 failed / 9008 passed EXIT=1 at 9457ce8af, the base arm 157 failed plus 4 errors at 008a18f12, added failure ids 0, and a negative-control log path.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares ten test paths plus the evidence fragment; the diff touches tests/conftest.py, tests/test_concurrency_bound_refuses_by_name.py, tests/test_dispatch_places_into_the_shared_reservation.py and the fragment, all inside the declared set.

justifications.durability: tests/test_dispatch_places_into_the_shared_reservation.py:244 runs a child pytest whose probe passes once the session guard is removed, so the committed check reddens on that mutation.
justifications.evidence: logs/suite-head2.log records 137 failed and 9008 passed at 9457ce8af and logs/suite-base2.log 157 failed plus 4 errors, giving 0 added ids, but manifest.md:11 names a control log evidencing a different mutation than the declaration.
justifications.fit: tests/conftest.py:92 names the guard by mechanism (_SCHEDULER_VERBS, reached_allocation_verbs) with no plan or ticket label, matching the module's existing style.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/conftest.py:376 refuses and records every scheduler verb, but only _ALLOCATION_VERBS at tests/conftest.py:103 fail a test, so a squeue, scontrol or scancel reach is not failed as the goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: the four diff paths are all inside the manifest's declared write paths, but manifest.md:8 omits tests/test_concurrency_bound_refuses_by_name.py from changed_paths.
